metadata.title: Göttingen S/M/P × D/L: A Semantic-Mathematical-Programming Framework for Auditing Mathematical Proofs
metadata.description:
v3.6 — G-series Zone-B Seal Package (pre-judgment deposition)

This version seals the complete G-series formal-round Zone-B corpus BEFORE Zone-C centralized judgment begins, providing externally-timestamped evidence that all blind-rebuild candidates pre-exist their historical comparison (analogous to the S8b v3.5 seal). Contents (34 files + commit-hash map): (1) Work orders: G-series v1.0-v1.3 (five-step flow, three-zone knowledge partition, round-batch freezing, RR seven-stage pipeline); (2) Protocol reviews: target-selection criteria with human M1-M6 / AI M7-M8 pattern catalogues, randomized-control designs, S5 completion-action tri-group, S1/S2 dichotomy operational rules; (3) Component taxonomy (24 slots, A1/A2 facets) + H36 dissection specimen; (4) Four freeze files (G1 pilot + formal-round G3prime-H37-Desargues / G4-H41-T2 / G5-Schoenfinkel) each with dual anchors, T-lock material packs, blacklists, derivation tables, negative constraints; (5) G1 pilot complete chain: 4 verbatim candidates, 4-reviewer PFE gate results, 4-judge G5 verbatim archives, closure report (C1/C3 unanimous bin-2 structural rebuild of linear logic); (6) Formal-round Zone-B: 12 verbatim candidates across 3 targets (4 models each), era-scanned, incl. the ternary-composition T(a,x,b) independently invented by three candidates (Hall 1943 direction), separation-hierarchy + Kolmogorov-quotient convergence (T0/T1/T2 direction), second-order-universality wall (Schoenfinkel boundary). All outputs verbatim per full-retention discipline.
